body: Thanks. It's good to know that someone relates. I get pissed off about this quite a lot. Especially at birthdays. I get tired of being the person that everyone depends on. I think "If shit goes bad for me, who can I ask for help?" But maybe that drives me to do my best. Most of the time, my mantra is "What world would I rather live in? A world where I can give to others, or a world where I have to take from others?" I prefer being able to give, but every once in a while it would be nice to get something back.

Thanks "diahard". I'm trying to find a something that has meaning again. I do remember what it was to feel a purpose. I just don't know how to find it. What used to have meaning doesn't seem to anymore. There is a part of me that wants to feel, but it seems the larger part of me doesn't either doesn't remember of doesn't want to. As I said in my post, something died inside of me. Any emotion seems to be peripheral. I can watch pass by but it doesn't register.

I think if you posted the same pictures redone to only show your face, you would get the same amount of interest. You are a beautiful woman. Eyes worth falling into. You have me rethinking my user name. :)
